newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - June 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - June 20.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Prime Minister Lionel Jospin presented the French with a social and ethical pact in his address to parliament yesterday, promises 700,000 jobs for the young, a four percent rise in minimum wage, a shift to a 35-hour work week over five years.
-- French and German authorities sign contract to set up production lines to build the Franco-German Tiger combat helicopter.
-- Moulinex posts symbolic first profit in five years.
-- LVMH increases its stake in GrandMet to 6.29 percent for an estimated total of eight billion francs.
